summary: Measure native build admission from durable accepted requests through capacity grant, including overdue open waiters

replay.detail: Host authority acquisition replays retained membership records into admission evidence before certifying the local source cut. Reads incrementally consume immutable claims; late grants preserve original deadline failures.

schema.detail: Registers system-only resource.admission.observed and resource.admission.coverage on resource-admission/HOST/ID and resource-admission/HOST, plus immutable system-only gate.admission.observed on gate-admission/HOST/ID/OUTCOME. All three remain durable replicated evidence with typed producer fields, without changing authoritative membership bytes or copying replayable grants.

rules.detail: build/admission/HOST/CLASS uses 90% within two hours over 30 days, with paired 14.4x 1h+5m and 6x 6h+30m burns. Refusal and withdrawal fail honestly; inherited contexts add no extra membership.

compatibility.detail: Only this process's acquired native host authority certifies complete coverage. Remote, malformed, clock-uncertain and unadmitted gate sources remain unknown, never green.

downtime.detail: No destructive state migration; new evidence becomes available after authority startup.

manual.detail: The optional transitional gate source requires matching producer and daemon spool directories and explicit deployment-owner complete-adoption proof before coverage admission. Completion receipts alone are insufficient.

recovery.detail: Authoritative membership data and immutable gate source receipts remain intact. Restart reconstructs request onset and deduplicates outcomes.
